# Mittal Collections

> Mittal Collections is an online home furnishing store based in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India, selling bedsheets, curtains, cushions, towels, doormats and related products.

Customers can browse the collection from anywhere in India. Delivery is currently available only to eligible PIN codes in Uttar Pradesh; availability is confirmed after PIN code verification. Delivery within 24 hours in selected Ghaziabad PIN codes, subject to product availability and order confirmation. Orders confirmed later in the day may be delivered the following day. Online payment (Razorpay) is supported, and Cash on Delivery may be available for eligible PIN codes and orders. Products can be returned per the return policy linked below.
